topic: how a credit card partner pays Delta Air Lines billions of dollars a year
storyAngle: Delta looks like an airline, but one of its biggest money streams is a credit card deal.
doNotClaim: Remuneration is what American Express pays Delta under the deal; it is not the same as revenue recognised in the year and not profit. NEVER give it as a percent or share of Delta revenue, profit or pre-tax income.
Do not say Delta earns more from the card than from flying.
Do not say what any cardholder pays or earns.

facts.claim: In 2024, remuneration from American Express to Delta totaled $7.4 billion (Delta 10-K, 2024).
Delta expects remuneration from American Express to grow to $10 billion over the long term.
Delta calls its American Express co-brand card relationship its most significant and valuable contract for selling miles.
Delta total operating revenue for 2024 was $61,643 million.
say: sixty one point six billion dollars
